answer: Give every identity a cipher key that signs each completed job, and make earning power climb a terrace of tiers: a new identity starts on the lowest terrace with near-zero payout, and rises only after a trail of distinct, independently verified jobs accumulates under its key. A comet of fresh fakes burns out fast: each fake must redo the whole climb, paying real compute and waiting real time per tier, while an honest agent's signed history compounds. Forging ten thousand identities means paying the full climb ten thousand times, so Sybil scale stops paying.
